In autonomous vehicles, image segmentation is employed to detect and locate objects like pedestrians, other vehicles, and road signs. Segmentation of satellite images can help classify land monitor types , cover deforestation, and assess urban growth . In microscopy images, segmentation is used to count cells, identify cell nuclei, and diagnose diseases . Image segmentation is crucial for scene understanding in AR applications, helping to identify and track objects in real-time video. FAST NUCES - Karachi Talha Shahid 5
